construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.query: Required nonblank string, at most 10000 characters
input.sources: Required list, 0..100 objects with exactly id, title, text; unique nonblank ids, nonblank titles, string texts up to 100000 characters

output.findings: Ranked array of {text, score, matched_terms, citation: {source_id, source_title, start, end}}

shared_schema.validation: One validate function checks input and source-backed evidence; JSON decoding rejects duplicate keys and nonstandard numeric constants.
shared_schema.citation_contract: Zero-based Unicode character offsets, start inclusive and end exclusive, into the exact supplied source text. Every finding text equals source.text[start:end].

cross_stage_handoffs: Single Research functionality: validated request -> passage spans -> token-overlap ranking -> validated extractive findings -> JSON output. No separate composition stages.

behavior.fixtures: All example documents and test source material are explicitly synthetic.
behavior.retrieval: Split at sentence-ending punctuation followed by whitespace and at line breaks. Trim boundary whitespace without changing source coordinates.
behavior.ranking: Case-folded Unicode word tokens; rank by number of distinct overlapping query tokens descending. Score is overlap/query-token count rounded to six decimals. Ties use input source order then character start.
behavior.extraction: Return exact matching passages, never generated paraphrases; preserve duplicate occurrences with their distinct citations.
behavior.empty_results: Empty sources, blank source texts, tokenless queries and unmatched terms return status ok with no findings.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object on stdout; exit 0 for success and 2 for validation or file errors.

included: Extractive findings with verifiable source citations
Bounded input sizes and output count
excluded: LLM calls or injected model hooks; none required
Semantic embeddings, stemming and stopword filtering
Linguistic sentence parsing, OCR and document format conversion
Fact checking, source credibility assessment and enterprise operation
